newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Promet in Indon oil venture.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Promet in Indon oil venture.

text.p: Promet Bhd said on Friday that it has agreed to enter a joint venture with two Indonesian parties to bid for oil and gas projects in Indonesia.
In a statement, the engineering and construction group said the pact is with PT Timah Tbk and PT Dok dan Perkapalan Air Kantung, a 72 percent shipbuilding unit of PT Timah.
Promet is participating in the venture through its wholly-owned Singapore unit, Promet Private Ltd.

"The parties will initially seek to be pre-qualified to tender for oil and gas projects in Indonesia. Upon obtaining the necessary prequalification licences, the joint venture will pursue such tenders and projects," the statement said.
Under the agreement, the Indonesian firms will be responsible for fabrication facilities, local administration, licences, labour and labour management.
Promet will provide engineering and design, project management and technical management, the statement said.
